Residential services

Choose the scope that best matches your home.

Each service page explains the work, planning considerations, materials, budget factors, and questions that shape a useful first conversation.

whole-home remodeling

Whole-Home Remodeling

A successful full-home renovation is more than a series of room updates. RT Signature Homes coordinates layout, structure, building systems, materials, permits, and construction sequencing so the finished home feels intentional from one space to the next.

Explore home remodeling

kitchen remodeling contractor

Kitchen Remodeling

RT Signature Homes approaches kitchen remodeling as a balance of circulation, storage, work zones, lighting, materials, and construction reality. Every visible finish depends on decisions behind the walls and inside the cabinets.

Explore kitchen remodeling

bathroom remodeling contractor

Bathroom Remodeling

Bathrooms concentrate plumbing, ventilation, electrical work, tile, cabinetry, glass, and moisture control in a compact footprint. RT Signature Homes plans those systems together so the room performs as well as it looks.

Explore bathroom remodeling

home addition contractor

Home Additions

An addition changes the structure, exterior, utilities, circulation, and relationship between old and new. RT Signature Homes coordinates those decisions as a single design-build scope.

Explore home additions

ADU builder

ADU Design & Construction

Accessory dwelling units require careful coordination of zoning, access, utilities, privacy, parking, structure, and compact-space design. RT Signature Homes brings feasibility, permitting, and construction into one process.

Explore adus

custom home builder

Custom Home Building

A custom home is a sequence of thousands of connected decisions. RT Signature Homes organizes feasibility, design, selections, permitting, estimating, construction, and closeout around a single accountable delivery process.

Explore custom homes

A connected process

Keep planning, selections, and construction moving together.

A residential project becomes harder when drawings, estimates, permits, selections, and fieldwork are treated as isolated handoffs. The RT process keeps those decisions connected to the property, priorities, and work that follows.

  • Investigate existing conditions before the scope hardens.
  • Keep selections and documentation ahead of construction milestones.
  • Give homeowners a clear path for questions and decisions.

Washington service area

Confirm the property, scope, and delivery needs before recommending a path.

RT Signature Homes evaluates qualifying residential projects across Washington, including Seattle and the Eastside, Vancouver, Spokane, and the Tri-Cities.

Regional climate, permitting context, material supply, site access, and construction logistics are considered during project qualification.

Explore service areas

Project fit

A useful consultation starts with the right questions.

Share enough context to evaluate the property and scope without forcing an instant answer for complex residential work.

One accountable team

Design, planning, permitting coordination, construction, and finish work stay connected through one project relationship.

Decisions before demolition

The site, structure, systems, scope, and material constraints are investigated before work is sequenced.

Proof over promises

Clear scopes, practical guidance, attributable reviews, and direct conversations do the work that generic claims cannot.

Common questions

Before you request a consultation

What kinds of projects are a fit for RT Signature Homes?

The team evaluates qualifying Washington residential projects including whole-home remodeling, kitchens, bathrooms, additions, ADUs, custom homes, exterior improvements, flooring, and painting.

When should I request a consultation?

Reach out while you are defining the scope, priorities, investment expectations, and timing. Early context makes the first project conversation more useful.

Will the first conversation provide an instant project price?

Complex residential work requires information about the property, existing conditions, scope, selections, access, and schedule before a responsible recommendation can be made.
